# .github/workflows

GitHub Actions CI/CD configuration directory managing automated binary builds and releases triggered by version tags.

## Contents

### [release.yml](./release.yml)
Automates cross-platform binary builds and GitHub releases via `bun run scripts/build.ts --target`.

## Architecture

Workflow runs on git tags matching `v*` pattern. Matrix strategy builds 5 platform targets with `fail-fast: false`:

1. Build job: runs `bun install` then `bun run scripts/build.ts --target ${{ matrix.target }} --verbose`, uploads artifacts as `llmux-${{ matrix.platform_suffix }}`
2. Release job: downloads all artifacts, creates draft GitHub release with `generate_release_notes: true`, marks prerelease if tag contains `-rc`, `-beta`, or `-alpha`

## Behavioral Contracts

Tag trigger pattern: `v*`

Platform matrix targets:
- `bun-darwin-x64` → `macos-13` (Intel)
- `bun-darwin-arm64` → `macos-14` (Apple Silicon)
- `bun-linux-x64` → `ubuntu-latest`
- `bun-linux-arm64` → `ubuntu-latest` with `use_qemu: true`
- `bun-windows-x64` → `windows-latest`

Artifact naming: `llmux-${{ matrix.platform_suffix }}`
